headline: Charlotte and Missouri State win again; Tulsa beaten away
dek: Missouri State's home win on Thursday was their thirteenth, the most of any side in the conference, and Charlotte won at home the same evening. Both travel on Sunday; Tulsa, beaten away on Thursday, have no match left on the schedule.

pattern.text: Scoring has not decided this conference. Memphis, whose bar stands tallest, have conceded 28 and won eight times, and they have lost as often as they have drawn.
